name: shop
semantics: Candidate 0 is the opaque guarded executor of the complete original purchase plan, potentially several purchases. It has item/count/cost/owned and projected-gold-after descriptors zero, with teacher_plan flag marking its identity. No first-purchase preview or duplicate build_for allocation is constructed. Other options save or attempt one shard/consumable purchase after immediate can_buy recheck. A failed recheck means save, never an illegal buy. No multi-turn commitment. Fixed deterministic narrowing: 12 shard types across all seven families plus teleport crystal and altar lock.
legality: Alternative masks come from SDK can_buy plus current affordability. Teacher complete plan remains legal by its unchanged guarded executor. All exact purchase guards remain deterministic.
candidate_ids: plan=0; save=1; shard=0x100+SDK item ID; consumable=0x200+SDK consumable ID

features.name: shard
features.description: Alternative shard purchase; zero for opaque teacher plan.

features.name: quantity
features.description: Alternative purchase count; zero for opaque teacher plan.

features.name: cost
features.description: Alternative exact cost; zero sentinel for opaque teacher plan, not a free-plan claim.

features.name: gold_after
features.description: Current gold minus alternative exact cost; zero sentinel for opaque teacher plan.

features.name: owned_shard_equivalent
features.description: Own shard count plus five times completed emblem count; zero sentinel for opaque teacher plan.

features.name: consumable_kind
features.description: SDK consumable ID for a consumable candidate.
